title: Rabbi Baitos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:4: Rabbi Yusti son of Rabbi Simon in the name of Rabbi Baitos. Hyman also finds Rabbi Yehoshua ben Baitos: Bereshit Rabbah 84:18.

notes.text: The supplied Hebrew cites Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 4:4. The named chain—Yusti son of Simon in the name of Baitos—is present at 6:4 in the consulted Guggenheimer digital text; the English citation is corrected accordingly. Bereshit Rabbah 84:18 directly names Yehoshua ben Baitos; the shared name does not establish a single identity.
